description: Hindu calendar (Panchang) for today or a specific date/time. Returns the 5 limbs: Tithi (lunar day), Nakshatra (lunar mansion), Yoga (luni-solar combination), Karana (half-tithi), and Vara (weekday). Also includes sunrise/sunset/moonrise times. Location defaults to Delhi if not specified. Cost: $0.012/call.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

element.description: Get full panchang (default) or a single element.

time.description: Time in HH:MM format (24h). Defaults to 12:00 (noon). Useful for eclipse timings or specific muhurta.

name: vedika_panchang
